editorialPrinciples.english: International English; concise, warm and non-deterministic.
editorialPrinciples.spanish: Neutral international Spanish; avoid country-specific slang and unnecessary gender assumptions.
editorialPrinciples.orientation: The canonical deck is upright only. Reversed or inverted language may appear only to explain that the product never uses it.
editorialPrinciples.responsibility: Symbolic language never becomes a diagnosis, secret proof, guaranteed outcome or substitute for a qualified professional.
editorialPrinciples.review: Authorial bilingual review; never a blind string-for-string substitution. Product rules and cultural clarity take priority over literal wording.

terms.note: Public subbrand; retain the celestial register.
